summary: Perplexity's startup program: $5,000 in API credits plus 3 months of Enterprise Pro for up to 50 seats. Eligibility: raised up to $20M in equity funding, less than 5 years old, associated with an approved Perplexity Startup Partner. Existing Enterprise Pro customers are not eligible. Note: older announcement copy said 6 months of Enterprise Pro; the current official page states 3 months.
claim_steps: Eligibility: ≤$20M equity funding raised, <5 years old, associated with an approved Startup Partner.
Existing Enterprise Pro subscribers are not eligible.
